[[Chkkr Thousand Tail]] is a [[Mantid]] [[boss]] that is found in [[Drazach Thicket]].

== Locations ==
* [[Echovald Forest]]
** {{NPC location|Drazach Thicket}}

== Skills ==
20 [[Marksmanship]] in [[Hard mode]]
* {{skill icon|Barrage}} ([[elite]])
* {{skill icon|Brambles}}
* {{skill icon|Needling Shot}}
* {{skill icon|Splinter Shot}}
* {{skill icon|Troll Unguent}}

== Items dropped ==
* [[Chitin Fragment]]
* [[Chkkr's Flatbow]] ([[unique]])
* [[Mantis Pincer]]
* [[Monstrous Eye]]

== Notes ==
* Chkkr Thousand Tail will fight with the nearby [[Warden]] [[patrol]]s.
* [[Oni]] will sometimes [[spawn]] near Chkkr before you reach him, and kill him.
* Occasionally, his group will not spawn when you enter the bosses range. Instead, they will spawn when you spawn either [[Bezzr Wingstorm]]s or [[Bazzr Icewing]]s group. This can be confusing when vanquishing.
* There are a few monsters with very similar names, possibly a family name within the game.
** [[Chkkr Brightclaw]]
** [[Chkkr Ironclaw]]
** [[Chkkr Locust Lord]]
